Class PasskeysController

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.passkey.PasskeysController
@RestController public class PasskeysController extends Object
GET /who/me/passkeys lists the caller's passkeys, oldest first; DELETE /who/me/passkeys/{credentialId} removes one. Both are for a browser session only: an API key or a bearer token, even beside a session cookie, is refused with 403. Registering a passkey (POST /who/me/passkeys/options, POST /who/me/passkeys) is Spring's WebAuthn filters'.

Removing a passkey needs a recent sign-in (ReauthenticationRequiredException, 401), and runs through the LastCredentialGuard: removing the identity's last sign-in credential is 409. A passkey that does not exist and one that belongs to someone else are both 404, so an id reveals nothing about other identities. A passkey is named by its WebAuthn credential id, never by its internal UUID, which is not shown.
